decisions.reason: A black-finish variant of the existing range costs little to carry and still has uncertain upside in the design-led bathroom trend, so the option is worth holding.
The shower channel has its own page, sits close to the core offer, and serves the growing barrier-free bathroom market, so it is cheap to keep and its value is still unfolding.

The pump-assisted solution is further from the core and only mentioned on the website, but one year of evidence has not resolved its uncertain value and its niche use in renovations justifies holding the option a while longer.
The tileable floor drain is a low-cost extension of established know-how, has its own page, and shows no sign that its value will fail to materialise.
The stainless steel design grate fits the firm's design-plus-engineering positioning, costs little to keep on the market, and still has unresolved upside.
